scholarships.name: Accommodation Bursary (Undergraduate, Home)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Must have applied for an undergraduate course starting Sep 2026 at Manchester.
eligibility.course_requirements: Any undergraduate course; must apply for eligible halls as first-choice accommodation.
eligibility.other_conditions: Requires Student Finance household-income assessment and consent to share data; household income must be £43,000 or below.

required_documents: Evidence for any priority criteria claimed in the bursary form

application_process.application_steps: Submit bursary form, have Manchester as firm choice by deadline, and provide supporting evidence for priority factors if claimed.

eligibility.academic_requirements: Applied for a Manchester undergraduate course starting Sep 2026.
eligibility.course_requirements: Unavailable for Medicine, Dentistry, and Architecture.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: For sanctuary-seeking applicants in the UK meeting specified immigration categories.
eligibility.other_conditions: Must be unable to access mainstream UK student finance due to immigration status.

application_process.application_steps: Apply to an eligible undergraduate course, then submit the Article 26 scholarship application when open.

scholarships.name: The Bason Family Bursary (Undergraduate, Home)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Applied for an undergraduate degree starting Sep 2026.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Home fee-status only; restricted to specified Black heritage ethnicity categories.
eligibility.other_conditions: Requires Student Finance assessment, household income <= £35,000, and current/long-term Greater Manchester residence.

required_documents: Evidence documents for any priority criteria claimed

application_process.application_steps: Submit one shared form (also used for Cowrie), then shortlisted candidates attend online interview.

scholarships.name: The Cowrie Foundation Scholarships (Undergraduate, Home)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Applied for an undergraduate degree starting Sep 2026.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Home fee-status only; restricted to specified Black heritage ethnicity categories.
eligibility.other_conditions: Requires Student Finance assessment and household income <= £35,000.

required_documents: Evidence documents for any priority criteria claimed

application_process.application_steps: Submit one shared form (also used for Bason), then shortlisted candidates attend online interview.

scholarships.name: The Sadler Bursary (Undergraduate, Home care-experienced)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Applied for an undergraduate degree starting Sep 2026.
eligibility.other_conditions: Must be care-experienced/care leaver and aged 24 or under on 1 Sep 2026.

required_documents: Local-authority/social-worker letter confirming care history and placement history
Evidence of living in Blackpool or North West since 1 Sep 2022
Evidence of being/were under care of a Blackpool/North West local authority

application_process.application_steps: Submit bursary form when open and upload required evidence; small panel shortlists and decides.

eligibility.academic_requirements: First master's qualification only; must have started UG after Sep 2012 and graduated no earlier than Jun 2021.
eligibility.course_requirements: Eligible master's courses only; full-time or part-time (max 2 years), Sep 2026 start.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Home fee status for both undergraduate and master's studies.
eligibility.other_conditions: Applicants must also meet at least one widening-participation priority criterion and provide evidence.

application_process.application_steps: Complete bursary application form and upload evidence; awards are then prioritized among eligible applicants.

scholarships.name: Global Futures Scholarships (International UG and Master's)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Must hold an offer for full-time on-campus study starting Sep 2026.
eligibility.english_language_requirement: Course-offer requirements apply; scholarship page gives no standalone threshold.
eligibility.course_requirements: Full-time on-campus undergraduate or master's only.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Only applicants living in listed eligible countries/regions.

required_documents: Online scholarship form emailed to relevant offer-holders

application_process.application_steps: Secure eligible Manchester offer; complete region-specific scholarship form sent by the International Office.

eligibility.academic_requirements: Strong prior academic performance and application to eligible Sep 2026 undergraduate study.
eligibility.english_language_requirement: No proof needed at scholarship application stage; must later meet offer-set English condition. Duolingo not accepted.
eligibility.course_requirements: Most 3-year UG and approved foundation routes; excludes Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing, Architecture and INTO Humanities foundation.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Must not currently live in UK/EU; for people displaced by recent conflict.
eligibility.other_conditions: Must be at serious conflict-related risk, displaced within last 3 years, unable to continue university, and not previously studied in UK/EU.

application_process.application_steps: Apply via UCAS, then submit scholarship form; no interview; scholarship decision sent by email.

eligibility.academic_requirements: Excellent bachelor's degree (typically top 10% of class), with graduation before Sep 2024.
eligibility.minimum_gpa_or_percentage: Top 10% of class (typical benchmark); exact GPA conversion NOT_FOUND.
eligibility.course_requirements: Only specific eligible master's courses (full-time on-campus or selected part-time online).
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Resident citizens of Ethiopia, Malawi, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, or Zimbabwe.
eligibility.other_conditions: Need >=2 years relevant paid professional experience; prior study outside Africa generally not allowed (except short <=6 months training).

application_process.application_steps: Apply in scholarship window first; if eligible, submit academic course application; shortlist requires admission offer.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships 2026 (International Master's)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Must hold a conditional or unconditional Manchester offer for an eligible one-year master's.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Manchester awards restricted to citizens/residents of Bangladesh, Ghana, or Pakistan.
eligibility.other_conditions: Additional selection rules are in linked University eligibility-and-selection PDF.

required_documents: Scholarship form emailed to relevant offer-holders

application_process.application_steps: Receive eligible Manchester offer, then submit GREAT scholarship form sent by International Office.

scholarships.name: Women in STEM Scholarships 2026-27 (International Master's)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Must meet Manchester academic entry standards and have completed undergraduate degree (or complete before enrolment).
eligibility.english_language_requirement: Must meet Manchester English requirement for course admission.
eligibility.course_requirements: Specific eligible STEM master's programmes only.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Women permanent residents/passport holders of Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan, or Sri Lanka.
eligibility.other_conditions: Must plan to return home for >=2 years, show STEM engagement and impact intent; ineligible with dual UK citizenship.

required_documents: Scholarship application form emailed to eligible offer-holders

application_process.application_steps: Hold relevant offer, complete scholarship form sent from mid-January, and consent to British Council data-sharing.

scholarships.name: Carbon Reduction Scholarship (Distance-learning MA Education for a Sustainable Environment)

eligibility.academic_requirements: Offer-holder for MA Education for a Sustainable Environment by distance learning.
eligibility.course_requirements: MA Education for a Sustainable Environment, distance-learning registration required.
eligibility.nationality_restrictions: Open to both home and overseas applicants.
eligibility.other_conditions: Selection is merit-based and based on contribution potential to programme diversity and enrichment.

application_process.application_steps: No separate bursary form; eligible applicants are assessed automatically.

data_freshness.notes: Used official manchester.ac.uk pages. Some schemes provide country/course-specific rules via linked PDFs or profiles; those fields are marked NOT_FOUND where page-level detail was unavailable or cycle timing was unclear.
